nom: Bioderma Sébium Foaming Gel Purifying Face Cleanser for Combination to Oily Skin

avis.texte: Both my boyfriend and I have combination/oily skin, especially in the sunmer time so I thought this would be beneficial for us as we do have excess sebum/sweat naturally but it was very drying, even for us. It triggered his eczema to flare up and made my skin flake. We only use a dime size amount too; had to return it immediately. Would not recommend.
